bagPolicy.summary: Attendees are allowed to bring backpacks and coolers in campgrounds, but not in festival grounds. Glass bottles and containers are prohibited in festival grounds.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking passes are required for those driving to the event. Attendees can enter during regular gate hours, but no overnight parking or roadside camping is allowed.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Lightning in a Bottle's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Lightning in a Bottle varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To help us continually make our event more accessible, we encourage you to contact us at ada@thedolab.com for any of your accessibility-related needs. Privacy Policy Terms & Conditions ADA/Accessibility FAQs ©2024 Lightning In A Bottle

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Lightning in a Bottle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: You will be able to go to Will Call to pick up your wristband at the onsite Box Office with a photo ID that matches the name on your order. Go to Will Call to pick up a new one at the on-site box office with an ID that matches the name on your order.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Lightning in a Bottle. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
